title: PlacedBet
description: One canonical placed-bet ledger row. Required fields are minimal (enough to identify the exact contract and stake); every analytical field is optional so a manually-entered chat-analysis bet can be logged immediately without blocking on missing fields.

betId.description: sha1(gameId + marketTicker + entryTimestamp) when entryTimestamp is known; sha1('bet_import' + importBatchId + sourceRow + marketTicker + side) when it is not (Timestamp-Optional Manual Imports milestone); else a time-ordered token. See lib/edgelab/ids.py:build_bet_id. Also serves as this record's idempotency key -- see lib/edgelab/bets.py:write_placed_bet.

gameDate.description: Slate date (ET calendar date), YYYY-MM-DD. Joinable from Game.gameDate via gameId; carried directly on the bet so date-range queries never require a Game join.

matchup.description: Human-readable 'AWAY @ HOME' display string, e.g. 'DET @ ATH'. Display only -- never parsed back into gameId (see lib/edgelab/ids.py's gameId fallback-collision note).

marketTicker.description: Exact Kalshi contract ticker — required so CLV can poll the exact market

marketHorizon.description: Joinable from Market.marketHorizon via marketTicker; carried directly on the bet so horizon-filtered queries (e.g. 'F5 performance') never require a Market join.

selection.description: Human-readable description of what was bought, e.g. 'PIT F5 moneyline'

entryPrice.description: 0-1 implied probability / Kalshi cents-as-fraction, the executed price

entryOdds.description: American odds captured AT ENTRY, if known. Display/audit only -- entryPrice (implied probability) remains the field every calculation (CLV, realized return) is derived from.

entryTimestamp.description: The ACTUAL wager placement time, when the user knows and supplies it. Null when not provided -- see timestampStatus/recordedAt. Never fabricated, never backfilled with recordedAt or any other logging time (Timestamp-Optional Manual Imports milestone).

recordedAt.description: When this row was written into the ledger (automatically generated UTC timestamp) -- set on every write through lib/edgelab/bets.py going forward, regardless of whether entryTimestamp is known. This is a LOGGING time, never represented as the placement time; date-range queries must use gameDate/entryTimestamp, never recordedAt. Null only for a pre-existing row written before this field existed (additive schema policy -- see data/edgelab/schema_v1/README.md's versioning policy); a reader must not treat null here as an error.

timestampStatus.description: PROVIDED: entryTimestamp is the user's real placement time. NOT_PROVIDED: entryTimestamp is null -- the user only supplied a game date and bet details, the normal timestamp-optional manual-import path. APPROXIMATE: a caller supplied a best-guess entryTimestamp it does not vouch for as exact (rare; prefer NOT_PROVIDED + null over guessing). Null only for a pre-existing row written before this field existed -- a reader must treat null the same as PROVIDED (every such row necessarily had a real entryTimestamp, since it was required before this milestone).

importBatchId.description: Stable identifier for the bulk-import batch (JSON file/payload) this bet came from, when logged via scripts/edgelab/import_bet_batch.py. Combined with sourceRow to form part of betId's identity when entryTimestamp is unknown -- see ids.py:build_bet_id. Null for bets logged through any other entry surface.

sourceRow.description: 0-based row index within importBatchId's payload. Distinguishes two genuinely separate tranches submitted in the same batch (each row keeps its own row index) from a true duplicate resubmission of the exact same row. Null when importBatchId is null.

source.description: Who identified the bet: a human analyst, the production model, or another origin. See entryMethod for HOW it was recorded into this ledger.

entryMethod.description: The concrete recording surface/workflow used to write this row -- distinct from `source` (who identified the bet). Null only for pre-existing rows written before this field existed; every write through lib/edgelab/bets.py:write_placed_bet sets it explicitly.

modelEvaluationId.description: Link to the ModelEvaluation this bet's model-derived fields were sourced from, when one genuinely exists (Phase 2 Milestone 3, docs/EDGELAB_MODEL_EVALUATION.md) -- never fabricated for a manual bet with no model evaluation. Set from the linked Recommendation's own modelEvaluationId, not independently derived.

productionRunId.description: The production decision run (snapshot_manifest.schema.json's productionRunId / productionRunKey) this bet's recommendation, if any, was decided under. Never fabricated for a manual bet with no production run.

snapshotId.description: Link to the immutable Snapshot (snapshot_manifest.schema.json) captured for this bet's decision moment, when one exists.

replayRunId.description: Link to a ReplayRun (replay_run.schema.json) that replayed this bet's decision moment, when one exists. Never set at entry time -- only ever backfilled after a replay actually runs.

modelSupported.description: True only when a real ModelEvaluation/Recommendation backs this bet's model fields (modelEvaluationId is set). False for a manual bet the model has no coverage for. Null only for pre-existing rows written before this field existed -- never guessed for them.

correlationGroup.description: DEPRECATED — a single legacy correlation group. New writes should use correlationGroups (plural, array) instead; kept for backward compatibility with existing rows, never removed (additive-only schema policy).

correlationGroups.description: Groups bets that share the same underlying game/market outcome risk. Plural, matching ModelEvaluation.correlationGroups' shape -- a bet may belong to more than one correlation group. Zero or more.

trackingType.description: Whether this bet counts toward real bankroll — see lib/tracking_type.py. Preserved distinctly from status/result so aggregate P/L never silently mixes paper and real stakes.

thesisTags.description: Controlled vocabulary — see data/edgelab/schema_v1/tags.json. Zero or more.

rationale.description: Free-text notes, kept separate from structured tags

recordStatus.description: Ledger-record lifecycle, distinct from `status` (settlement lifecycle: pending/settled/void). ACTIVE is the normal state for every genuinely-placed bet. CORRECTED marks a row whose content was explicitly overwritten via an on_conflict='overwrite' write (see write_placed_bet) -- the row itself still IS the bet, just with corrected fields. CANCELLED marks a bet that was logged in error and should be excluded from ROI/postmortem/bankroll aggregation without deleting the audit trail -- see cancel_placed_bet. Null only for pre-existing rows written before this field existed; a reader must treat null the same as ACTIVE.

recordStatusReason.description: Free-text explanation for a non-ACTIVE recordStatus -- required by cancel_placed_bet for CANCELLED, optional for CORRECTED. Null for ACTIVE rows.

reconciliation.description: Present only when this bet's entryPrice/entryOdds, once flagged ambiguous by the source-scoped normalizer (see lib/edgelab/bets.py's _classify_price_value), was later confirmed correct through a documented, evidence-backed manual review -- never set by any automatic normalization rule, and never itself changes entryPrice/entryOdds (those are set exactly once, by normal ingestion). Records exactly what resolved the ambiguity so a future reader never re-flags this row as an unverified guess. Null for every ordinary row -- most bets never go through this.

classification.description: Matches the reconciliation-review classification taxonomy (SAFE_AUTOMATIC_FIX / SAFE_MANUAL_FIX / AMBIGUOUS_REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION / INVALID_SOURCE_VALUE / LEAVE_UNCHANGED) -- only SAFE_MANUAL_FIX rows ever reach this field; the other classifications by definition don't produce a resolved value to record.

originalSourceFile.description: The legacy file this bet was originally ingested from, e.g. data/bets.json

originalSourceIndex.description: The row index within originalSourceFile, matching provenance.sourceKey

originalRawValue.description: The raw entryPrice-shaped value as it appeared in the source file, before any interpretation

corroboratingArtifactPath.description: Repo-relative path to the independent artifact that corroborated the interpretation (e.g. an execution-slip file) -- never the same file as originalSourceFile

corroboratingArithmetic.description: Free-text statement of the exact arithmetic identity or cross-field match that corroborated the interpretation, e.g. 'rawEdgePct == modelProb - entryPrice'

reconciledAt.description: When this reconciliation was performed -- fixed at the time of the review, never regenerated on a rerun, so a repeat run of the reconciliation script is byte-identical

reconciliationMethod.description: e.g. MANUAL_CROSS_ARTIFACT_REVIEW -- always a specific, named, human-driven method, never a generalized code-level inference rule

generalizedInferenceRuleUsed.description: Always false for a SAFE_MANUAL_FIX row -- present explicitly so a reader never has to infer it. This kind of cross-artifact archaeology is never baked into the normalizer as a rule applied to other rows.

marketObservationLinkage.description: Automatic linkage (Bet-to-Observation Linkage milestone) between this manually-entered bet and the best archived pregame MarketObservation for the exact same marketTicker -- never a claim that the observation's capturedAt IS the placement time (entryTimestamp/recordedAt remain the only timestamp fields with that meaning). Null when no matching observation was found (linkageStatus would be UNLINKED) or linkage was never attempted.

observationId.description: MarketObservation.marketObservationId this bet is linked to

marketCorpusRunId.description: The runId (ResearchRunMetadata) that captured the linked observation

observedAt.description: The linked observation's own capturedAt -- context only, never the bet's placement time

observedPrice.description: yesAsk (or side-appropriate price) at the linked observation, for comparison against the user's own reported entryPrice

unavailableReason.description: Set when linkageStatus is UNLINKED, e.g. 'no_pregame_observation_for_ticker'

clvQuoteId.description: Link to the ClvQuote record used as the closing reference

clv.description: Percentage points, entry implied prob minus closing implied prob (see CLV formula doc)
